description.value: Galiano Garage is a convenience store on Galiano Island, one of the Southern Gulf Islands accessible by BC Ferries. The island has very limited services, making any convenience stop potentially valuable for touring cyclists navigating its quiet rural roads. The name suggests the business may also offer vehicle-related services alongside retail goods, though this could not be confirmed.
